name: change-parity
note: A change asks for a script nobody registered, so the Script port refuses it and the change faults; then a confirmation of a digest the change never planned is refused. Proves Request dispatches and starts the Examine ask, the refusal reaches Fault, and Confirm holds its digest guard. A script that plans and applies needs one registered with the adapter, which a corpus run has none of, so spec/change_chapter_spec.rb walks that path.
